record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; the listed result files are not included.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports outcomes from mean-difference direction removal and weight edits, but does not establish that these reproduce the original intervention in all its stated details.
record.gate_note: The README reports refusal and perplexity outcomes for inference-time and weight-based ablation. It also describes an evaluation harness and names other scripts, but those details alone are not results. The listed RESULTS.md and report files were not provided.
record.test_reason: The repo applies difference-in-means refusal-direction ablation, both at inference time and as weight edits, to Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. It reports harmful refusal, benign false-refusal and wikitext-2 perplexity before and after, so it bears on V1 and V2. It is T2 rather than T1 because it uses matched-pair extraction, a custom n=40 refusal eval and strength-scaled baking that differ from the original setup. Evidence is README status lines only; RESULTS.md and report files were not provided.
record.authors_conclusion: Largely correct. The README reports that inference-time ablation eliminates harmful refusal (97.5%→0%) at a +57% perplexity cost. Standard weight baking (s=1.0) removes only ~30pp, which the authors attribute to orthogonalization not cleaning what earlier tokens wrote. Over-orthogonalization at s=2.0 is their export answer: 17.5% refusal, perplexity 12.87, surviving Q4 quantization. The resulting model is published on HF.
record.recipe_differences: The README describes matched-pair, per-layer mean-difference extraction and inference-time projection removal, plus separate weight-orthogonalization and baking approaches. It does not specify the original intervention's complete layer-and-position procedure. Repository type: tool/pipeline based on the cited work and community notebooks.
record.method_sensitivity: Outcome varies with layer choice and weight-edit approach: single-layer ablation has no effect; all-layer weight ablation is partial and raises perplexity; the README reports different refusal and perplexity outcomes for baking conditions.
record.problems: Only README-reported summaries are available; the named report files were not provided. Sample size n=40 is stated for some evaluations, but no uncertainty estimates are given. Capability evidence is limited to perplexity.
record.rows_left_out: No additional reported results could be extracted from the listed RESULTS.md or results/report files because their contents were not included. The README's metric table only says metrics are tracked and gives no outcomes.

record.verdict_notes: Hobbyist repo, README summaries only, n=40, no uncertainty. The weight-edit rows were moved from V1 to V2 only. Rows r7/r8 and r12/r13 appear to describe the same s=1.0 bake. The gap between inference-time and weight-edit results suggests the weight edit is not equivalent to the original directional ablation in this implementation; the repo may differ from the original recipe.
